Interface VirtualView

All Known Implementing Classes:
RmiVirtualView, TcpVirtualView
public interface VirtualView
Outbound channel from the server to one specific client. The Model/Controller uses this to push ServerMessage objects back to the client, regardless of whether the transport is TCP or RMI.
